decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Novak Djokovic finished the year as world No. 1, while document d2 shows Rafael Nadal was No. 1 on November 12, 2019, but the year-end status is confirmed by d1; document d3 contains a contradictory claim that Nadal finished as No. 1, which conflicts with the specific 'year-end' phrasing in d1 and the timeline in d2 where Nadal lost the top spot before year-end.
